description: This file contains the implementation of a service that communicates with the OpenAI API, specifically the OpenAIChatService class, along with related enums and exception classes for handling errors. It handles sending messages to the API, processing responses, and error management.

classes.name: ChatGPTError
classes.description: Enum representing different types of errors that can occur when interacting with the OpenAI API.

classes.name: ChatGPTException
classes.description: Custom exception class wrapping ChatGPTError and providing human-readable messages.

classes.name: OpenAIChatService
classes.description: A service class that communicates with the OpenAI API to send chat messages and handle responses.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a list of ChatMessage objects to the OpenAI API and returns the assistant's reply as a string.

methods.name: _extractOpenAIErrorDetail
methods.description: Extracts error details from an HTTP response when the API returns an error.

methods.name: _extractTextFromResponsesOutput
methods.description: Parses the API response JSON to extract the assistant's output text from the 'output' field.

methods.name: _extractTextFromChatCompletions
methods.description: Attempts to extract the assistant's reply from a chat completion-style response.
